Re-ruled within R70-100 to R70-138: escalation as a pacing register is legal inside a practitioner's duel while reserve lasts (R70-102-STILLNESS_TRACED_PASSES_LONG; R60-03-HARD_RESERVE_CLOCK ends it); absurdist method beside genuine stakes gives way to comedy set hard against dread by design, each played straight, while inside the danger only gallows wit is legal, so that tell still holds there (R70-116-COMEDY_BESIDE_DANGER). R70-112-FACE_FACE_SLAP licenses the face-slap (a public reversal the room reassesses, with a bill) but names no tell on this list; the room's reassessment is where it meets reaction shots as characterisation, which R70-72 re-rules for crowds. Still tells as far as R70-100 to R70-138 reach: personality vomiting, reaction shots as characterisation, loud opinions as a default register, bizarre or exaggerated minor NPCs (R70-122-MAY_CARRY_ONE gives minor NPCs comic names, not exaggerated conduct) and humour as a tone exception (R70-113-DOUBLE_ACT_COMIC_BEAT keeps full comic beats a property of carded comic voices).
